audit_metadata.grade_explanation: 3 P1 findings exceed the C threshold (max_p1: 2). Grade improves to C if DEP-001 confirmed phantom. Improves to B once QO-001 + QO-002 resolved.

escalations.title: Handlebars.js Critical JavaScript Injection (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.status: PHANTOM_DEPENDENCY — verify with: npm cache clean --force && cd Source/Backend && npm install && npm ls handlebars
escalations.immediate_action: Verify installation before next release. If confirmed installed, update to handlebars@4.7.8+. If phantom, document as false positive.
escalations.exploit_scenario: AST type confusion allows attacker-controlled template input to execute arbitrary JavaScript server-side. Zero authentication required if any public endpoint passes user input through Handlebars.
escalations.recommendation: 1) npm cache clean --force && npm install && npm ls handlebars  2) If installed: npm update handlebars  3) Trigger TheGuardians for full template injection surface assessment

p1_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Blind Spot — portal/ and platform/ Never Scanned
p1_findings.impact: 7 of 8 plans produce false failures or are completely unchecked. CI reports TRACEABILITY PASSED based on one plan only.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add 'portal' and 'platform' to source_dirs in traceability-enforcer.py or read from inspector.config.yml → source.dirs. Update default-run output to name which plan was checked.

p1_findings.title: Requirement ID Collision — FR-070 through FR-076 claimed by two plans
p1_findings.impact: ~36 portal references to FR-070–FR-076 are ambiguous between image-upload and orchestrator-cycle-dashboard. Traceability is broken for both plans.
p1_findings.recommendation: Renumber orchestrator-cycle-dashboard FRs to FR-OCD-001–007 (or FR-090–096). Update all // Verifies: comments in portal orchestrator components. Create a central FR ID registry.

p2_findings.title: Direct DB Access in Route Handler — No Service Layer
p2_findings.impact: Violates architecture rule: no direct DB calls from route handlers. Also: inline TeamDispatch interface (belongs in portal/Shared/types.ts), missing traceability comment.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/services/teamDispatchService.ts. Move TeamDispatch to portal/Shared/types.ts. Add // Verifies: once FR assigned.

p2_findings.title: 3 Open dependency-linking Implementation Items
p2_findings.impact: Type safety broken end-to-end for dependency PATCH operations. DependencyPicker uses unsafe as any casts in production. No seed data for testing dependency chains.
p2_findings.recommendation: Dispatch backend-coder for blocked_by field + seed.ts; dispatch frontend-coder for missing test files.

p2_findings.title: UUID Buffer Bounds Check Missing (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.impact: Missing bounds check in v3/v5/v6 UUID generation when buf parameter provided. Can cause buffer overflow / memory corruption.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update uuid@14.0.0 in Source/Backend. Check if any caller uses buf parameter (API change). Run full test suite.

p2_findings.title: Pino Logging Library 2 Major Versions Behind
p2_findings.impact: Critical logging path missing security patches from v9 and v10.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update pino@10.3.1 in Source/Backend. Review v9/v10 migration guides for API changes.

p2_findings.title: Deprecated glob Package with Known Security Vulnerabilities
p2_findings.impact: Deprecated with known security vulnerabilities. Inherited through test/build toolchain.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade dependencies that use glob to modern glob v10+ alternatives. Coordinate with toolchain upgrade sprint.

p2_findings.title: Deprecated supertest (Backend Testing Framework)
p2_findings.impact: Dev dependency critical for CI pipeline. Deprecated with recommendation to upgrade.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update supertest@7.1.3 in Source/Backend. Should be backward compatible.

p3_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline plan has no requirements.md — enforcer cannot gate it
p3_findings.recommendation: Create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md by extracting FR-TMP-001–010 from Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md. Prerequisite: QO-001 fix.

p3_findings.title: 5 Production Files Exceed 500-Line Threshold
p3_findings.recommendation: Schedule for next refactor pass. Priority: detail components first.

p3_findings.title: React Router Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URL (CVSS 5.4)
Deprecated inflight — Memory Leak in glob Ecosystem
esbuild CORS Bypass in Dev Server (CVSS 5.3)
p3_findings.note: Requires npm audit fix --force (breaking Vite change). Assess trade-off carefully.

p4_findings.title: 3 Undocumented eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps Suppressions
p4_findings.recommendation: Add inline comments explaining why each suppression is safe (e.g., fetch-on-mount pattern). Review for stale closure risks.
